text:
Maya: Quick triage — VectorSherpa onboarding. FP32 baseline looks solid but PTQ 6-bit per-tensor dropped recall@10 on short queries (~<=8 tokens). Minimal repro below.
Jun: which slice/dataset? short_seq_holdout?
Maya: yes. Ran: 
```bash
./eval_embeddings --model vector_sherpa/fp32 --dataset short_seq_holdout --metric recall@10
./eval_embeddings --model vector_sherpa/ptq6 --dataset short_seq_holdout --metric recall@10
```
output (sample): 
```
baseline recall@10: 0.742
ptq6 recall@10: 0.674
delta: -0.068 (~9.2%)
```
Rafael: two likely issues: per-tensor scale induced directional bias, or whitening/PCA mismatch applied before/after quant. Did you keep preprocessing identical?
Maya: preprocessing identical. I emulated per-channel quant on CPU and saw partial recovery: ptq6-perchannel -> 0.707.
Priya: ok signal. Try 4k calibration (holdout) with asymmetric quant and per-channel only on projection matrix. Short queries are sensitive to small angle shifts.
Maya: running that + bias-correction on proj layer (512 samples). Quick local run (per-channel on linears): recall@10 0.709 noisy.
Jun: also disable range-folding on final projection — we saw tail compression with Hummingbird before.
Rafael: add histogram of top-k similarities; if distances compress toward zero after quant, kNN ordering breaks.
Maya: adding histogram metric in eval: 
```python
# inside eval
dists = query_vecs @ db_vecs.T  # cosine after L2 norm
hist, bins = np.histogram(dists, bins=40)
```
Priya: also compare PCA components pre/post quant (angle between leading eigenvectors) to detect rotation drift.
Maya: plan: 1) per-channel PTQ with 4k calib (asymmetric), 2) bias-corr 512 on proj, 3) disable range-folding last layer, 4) collect recall@10/@100 & MAP + histograms + PCA-drift, 5) propose short-query fallback (route to fp32 for queries <=8 tokens). ETA ~2h on staging.
ci-bot: test-run vector-sherpa ptq6-perchannel started on staging (run id: rs-2026-06-03-81).
Jun: include recall@100 and MAP; higher-k recovery affects product tradeoffs.
Rafael: if recovery <5% after these, consider INT4 mixed with FP residuals for projection or quant-aware fine-tune for projection layer.
Maya: will post results. For release notes: mark vector_sherpa/ptq6 as "requires per-channel calibration" and don't enable as default in canary until we get short-query parity.
ci-bot: run rs-2026-06-03-81 completed, eval payload uploaded to s3://redwood-eval/vector_sherpa/rs-2026-06-03-81.json
Maya: thanks — pinging @Rafael and @Priya for follow-ups once I have numbers. :thumbsup:
